CVE-2026-132138.title: cyrus-sasl: SCRAM channel-binding NULL dereference allows remote denial of service
CVE-2026-132138.description: A flaw was found in cyrus-sasl. When processing authentication requests using the Salted Challenge Response Authentication Mechanism (SCRAM), a remote attacker can trigger a null pointer dereference by submitting unexpected channel-binding data. This causes the server process to crash before validating authentication proofs, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).
